summary: IAMGOLD filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results news release dated November 5, 2026. The company reported attributable production of 186,900 ounces, revenue of $856.5 million, mine-site free cash flow of $404 million, liquidity of $1.6 billion, and $135 million of buybacks in the quarter (nearly $600 million total). No transaction, stake, price per share, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings report, not a special situation.
